AlgoCfg.description:
Technical configuration of a specific ML algorithm in the pipeline.

Stores the algorithm enablement settings, overridden search spaces,
and paths to the trainer and tuner modules.
Attributes:
    enable (bool): Flag for the algorithm's participation in the current experiment.
    limit_hyperparameters (bool): Restrict the search to the user-listed
        hyperparameters only (no DEFAULT_SPACES entries).
    hyperparameters (Dict | None): Custom parameter bounds
        overriding the default values.
    tuner (str): Dotted path to the optimizer module.
    trainer_module (str): Dotted path to the model training implementation.

enable.description: Whether to use this algorithm in the AutoML pipeline
enable.title: Enable

limit_hyperparameters.description: Restrict the search to ONLY the parameters listed in 'hyperparameters'; every other parameter stays at the estimator default (no DEFAULT_SPACES entries are added). false (default) — user ranges override and are merged into DEFAULT_SPACES.
limit_hyperparameters.title: Limit Hyperparameters

hyperparameters.description: Keys must correspond to the algorithm's allowed hyperparameters: the constructor parameters of the sklearn estimator (including legacy names from LEGACY_PARAM_MAPPINGS). The source of truth is models.get_allowed_hyperparameters.
hyperparameters.title: Hyperparameters

preprocessing.description: Explicit override of the feature preprocessing preset for this algorithm. Set partially or fully: 'imputation_strategy' ('mean'|'median') and/or 'scaling' ('standard'|'robust'|'none'). Takes precedence over the automatic choice based on the algorithm class. None — automatic selection.

tuner.description: Path to the tuner module for hyperparameter optimization
tuner.title: Tuner

trainer_module.description: Dotted path to the module containing the `ModelTrainer` class(for example, 'configurable_automl_engine.trainer').
trainer_module.title: Trainer Module

AlgoCfg.title: AlgoCfg

ComplexityGuardCfg.description:
Settings of the adaptive complexity guard for tree/boosting spaces.

Extends the data-dependent clipping layer (``clip_search_space``): on
small data the search ranges of tree/boosting hyperparameters are too
wide, trials are spent on values that do not change the model, the TPE
surface has flat regions and the search drifts toward overfit models.
This section tightens the ranges depending on the number of rows (``n``)
and the feature count.

Two feature counts are used deliberately: the size-mode ratio ``n / p``
uses the ORIGINAL column count (a categorical column counts as 1, before
the one-hot expansion), so that large-but-wide data (one-hot expanded)
is not pushed into a smaller size mode; the rules that depend on the
feature count (``max_features``, ``colsample_bytree``) use ``p`` after
preprocessing — what the model sees.

Two independent levels of restrictions:
* level A — lossless clipping: removes values that cannot change the
  model on data of the given size (``lossless``). For ``min_samples_leaf``
  the cap is a physical bound (larger leaves are unreachable on the sample
  size), not a claim about model quality;
* level B — regularization: deliberately shifts the space toward simpler
  models on small data (``regularize``). For boosting this includes the
  ``n_estimators`` budget — the tree count together with
  ``learning_rate`` is the main complexity regulator of a boosting
  ensemble;
* level "time" — time-only caps of bagging ensembles (``n_estimators``
  of random forest / extra trees): more trees only reduce the variance
  of the ensemble.

Attributes:
    mode (ComplexityGuardMode): Operation mode: 'off' — disabled,
        'warn' — restrictions are computed and logged but NOT applied,
        'apply' — computed and applied.
    lossless (bool): Enable level A (lossless clipping).
    regularize (bool): Enable level B (regularization heuristic).
    user_range_policy (ComplexityGuardUserRangePolicy): Policy for an
        empty intersection of a user range (``algo.hyperparameters``)
        with the guard range: 'user_wins' (default) — the user range
        stays, 'engine_wins' — the guard restriction is applied.
    small_n_threshold (int): ``n < threshold`` marks the 'small' mode.
    small_np_ratio_threshold (float): ``n / p < threshold`` marks the
        'small' mode. ``p`` is the ORIGINAL column count (a categorical
        column counts as 1, before one-hot expansion).
    medium_n_threshold (int): ``n < threshold`` marks the 'medium' mode.
    medium_np_ratio_threshold (float): ``n / p < threshold`` marks the
        'medium' mode. ``p`` is the ORIGINAL column count (a categorical
        column counts as 1, before one-hot expansion).
    size_basis (ComplexityGuardSizeBasis): Basis of ``n``: 'rows' (default)
        — independent rows, 'groups' — reserved for group validation.

mode.description: Operation mode of the adaptive complexity guard: 'apply' (default) — restrictions are computed and applied, 'warn' — computed and logged but NOT applied, 'off' — disabled (search spaces are unchanged).

lossless.description: Enable level A (lossless clipping): removes values that cannot change the model on data of the given size (e.g. max_depth=25 on 15 rows is equivalent to max_depth=6). Safe. For min_samples_leaf the cap is a physical bound (larger leaves are unreachable on the sample size), not a claim about model quality.
lossless.title: Lossless

regularize.description: Enable level B (regularization): deliberately shifts the space toward simpler models on small data. A heuristic.
regularize.title: Regularize

user_range_policy.description: Policy for an empty intersection of a user range (algo.hyperparameters) with the guard range: 'user_wins' (default) — the explicit user range stays (a warning is logged), 'engine_wins' — the guard restriction is applied.

small_n_threshold.description: Row threshold of the 'small' mode: n < threshold marks the data as small.
small_n_threshold.title: Small N Threshold

small_np_ratio_threshold.description: Ratio threshold of the 'small' mode: n / p < threshold marks the data as small (wide data with few rows per feature). p is the ORIGINAL column count (a categorical column counts as 1, before the one-hot expansion).
small_np_ratio_threshold.title: Small Np Ratio Threshold

medium_n_threshold.description: Row threshold of the 'medium' mode: n < threshold marks the data as medium.
medium_n_threshold.title: Medium N Threshold

medium_np_ratio_threshold.description: Ratio threshold of the 'medium' mode: n / p < threshold marks the data as medium. p is the ORIGINAL column count (a categorical column counts as 1, before the one-hot expansion).
medium_np_ratio_threshold.title: Medium Np Ratio Threshold

size_basis.description: Basis of the row count n for the size mode: 'rows' (default) — independent rows, 'groups' — reserved for group validation (repeats of one group carry less information than independent rows); only 'rows' is used today.

ComplexityGuardCfg.title: ComplexityGuardCfg

ComplexityGuardMode.description: Operation modes of the adaptive complexity guard.
ComplexityGuardMode.title: ComplexityGuardMode

ComplexityGuardSizeBasis.description: Basis of the row count ``n`` for the size mode.
ComplexityGuardSizeBasis.title: ComplexityGuardSizeBasis

ComplexityGuardUserRangePolicy.description: Policy for an empty intersection of a user range with the guard range.
ComplexityGuardUserRangePolicy.title: ComplexityGuardUserRangePolicy

FeatureSelectionCfg.description:
Settings of the feature selection mechanism.

Attributes:
    mode (FeatureSelectionMode): Operation mode: 'disabled', 'always'
        or 'auto'.
    method (FeatureSelectionMethod): Selection algorithm: 'importance',
        'percentile', 'mutual_info' or 'variance'.
    percentile (float): Percentage of the best features to keep
        (0 < percentile <= 100) for the 'percentile' and 'mutual_info'
        methods.
    min_features (int): Guaranteed minimum number of features (>= 1),
        protects against an empty feature matrix.
    variance_threshold (float): Minimum feature variance (>= 0.0)
        for the 'variance' method.
    n_estimators (int): Number of trees in the ensemble (>= 10)
        for the 'importance' method.

mode.description: Feature selection mode: 'disabled', 'always' or 'auto'. By default 'disabled' — feature selection is not applied.

percentile.description: Percentage of features to keep (for the 'percentile' and 'mutual_info' methods).
percentile.title: Percentile

min_features.description: Lower bound on the number of features kept (protection against an empty feature matrix).
min_features.title: Min Features

variance_threshold.description: Minimum feature variance for the 'variance' method.
variance_threshold.title: Variance Threshold

n_estimators.description: Number of trees used to estimate feature importance in the 'importance' method.
n_estimators.title: N Estimators

FeatureSelectionCfg.title: FeatureSelectionCfg

FeatureSelectionMethod.description: Supported algorithms for reducing the feature space.
FeatureSelectionMethod.title: FeatureSelectionMethod

FeatureSelectionMode.description: Operation modes of the feature space reduction mechanism.
FeatureSelectionMode.title: FeatureSelectionMode

FloatSpace.description: Distribution for floating-point numbers: [min, max, 'float', step?].
FloatSpace.title: FloatSpace

GeneralCfg.description:
General settings of the AutoML process, validation, and parallelism.

The central control node of the experiment, responsible for choosing
metrics, quality evaluation strategies (Cross-Validation / Hold-out),
and distributing computational resources.
Attributes:
    comparison_metric (ComparisonMetric): Main metric for ranking models.
    additional_metrics (List[ComparisonMetric]): Additional informational
        metrics, computed for the final model with the same validation method
        used for model comparison (hold-out/CV, not train score).
    path_to_model (Path): Filesystem path for exporting the model artifact.
    serialization_format (SerializationFormat): Save format (pickle/joblib).
    log_to_file (Path | None): File for writing the engine's run logs.
    phases (List[HPOPhaseCfg]): Sequence of pipeline steps:
        HPO phases ('all_algorithms' / 'refine') and explicit selection
        steps ('select'); the last phase must be a select with output: winner.
        Defaults to ``all_algorithms`` + ``select(cv_best, winner)``.
    validation_strategy (ValidationStrategy): Evaluation method
        ('train_test_split', 'k_fold', 'loo' or 'auto').
    n_folds (int): Number of splits for cross-validation.
    random_state (int | None): The engine seed driving data splits, model
        seeds and the TPE sampler base seed (``random_state +
        phase_ordinal``); recorded in the report. None — the run is not
        reproducible (a WARNING is logged).
    categorical_encoding (EncodingStrategy): Encoding strategy for
        categorical features ('one_hot', 'ordinal', 'target', 'frequency'
        or 'hashing'). Default is 'one_hot'.
    parallel_strategy (str): Parallelization level (only by algorithms).
    max_workers (int | None): Limit on threads or processes.
    parallel_mode (str): Technical execution mode ('threads' or 'processes').
    feature_selection (FeatureSelectionCfg): Feature space reduction
        settings. By default mode='disabled' — feature selection is not applied.

comparison_metric.description: Metric for comparing models and choosing the best one (for example, r2, rmse, accuracy)
comparison_metric.title: Comparison Metric

additional_metrics.description: List of additional quality metrics, whose values are computed for the final trained model with the same validation method used for model comparison (hold-out scoring or the mean over CV folds), and are returned together with the training results (key 'additional_metrics'). The metrics are purely informational: they do not take part in hyperparameter optimization, model comparison, or winner selection. Valid values are the same as the set of comparison_metric values. Duplicates in the list are ignored (the value is counted once), and a match with the main comparison metric (including aliases, for example rmse ↔ neg_root_mean_squared_error) is excluded from the list — its value is already returned as 'score'. Both rules are applied during config validation, so the resulting list in general.additional_metrics may differ from the one originally passed by the user.
additional_metrics.title: Additional Metrics

path_to_model.description: Path for saving/loading the resulting trained model
path_to_model.title: Path To Model

log_to_file.description: Path to the log file. If not set, logs are printed to the console only
log_to_file.title: Log To File

phases.description: List of sequential pipeline steps. Default: one HPO phase over all algorithms followed by picking the best cross-validation score: [{action: all_algorithms, n_trials: 50}, {action: select, strategy: cv_best, output: winner}]
phases.title: Phases

validation_strategy.description: Quality evaluation strategy:k-fold cross-validation, fixed hold-out,LOO, or automatic selection

n_folds.description: Number of blocks (folds) for cross-validation.Used only when validation_strategy = 'k_fold'
n_folds.title: N Folds

random_state.description: The engine seed: drives the data splits (CV folds / hold-out), the model seeds (via the ModelTrainer and the model factory) and the TPE sampler base seed (random_state + hpo_phase_ordinal). It is recorded in the training report under the 'random_state' key. None — a non-deterministic run: the data splits are not fixed and stochastic models draw a fresh RNG at fit time; a WARNING is logged that the run is not reproducible.
random_state.title: Random State

holdout_fraction.description: Fraction of rows (in (0, 1)) reserved as an outer hold-out BEFORE hyperparameter optimization: these rows never participate in model selection and are used only to report the honest out-of-sample estimate result["holdout_score"] of the winner. The final model is still trained on ALL data (the hold-out rows are included in the final fit). 'auto' (default) — reserve 0.2 of the rows when the input has at least 100 rows; on smaller data no hold-out is reserved. None — no outer hold-out is reserved and the key is not reported. Without a hold-out result["score"] and result["oof_score"] are computed on the folds that selected the algorithm and hyperparameters and are optimistic; the honest estimate is then the bias-corrected (BBC-CV) result["bbc_score"].
holdout_fraction.title: Holdout Fraction

categorical_encoding.description: Encoding strategy for categorical features: 'one_hot' (each category -> a separate binary column), 'ordinal' (each categorical column -> one numeric column with an imposed order), 'target' (target encoding with smoothing), 'frequency' (category frequency) or 'hashing' (deterministic hashing into a fixed number of binary columns). Ordinal encoding does not increase the number of columns and is useful for linear models, but it imposes an artificial order on categories. Target/frequency/hashing are effective for high-cardinality columns.
categorical_encoding.title: Categorical Encoding

high_cardinality_threshold.description: Cardinality threshold for the automatic mode (>= 0). Columns with a number of unique values strictly greater than the threshold are encoded with the high_cardinality_encoding strategy (default 'frequency'), the rest — with the categorical_encoding strategy. Must be set together with high_cardinality_encoding. The default 50 enables the automatic high-cardinality mode out of the box; to disable it, set both this field and high_cardinality_encoding to null explicitly.
high_cardinality_threshold.title: High Cardinality Threshold

high_cardinality_encoding.description: Encoding strategy for high-cardinality columns (above high_cardinality_threshold; default 'frequency' — the relative category frequency, which does not expand the feature space). Must be set together with high_cardinality_threshold. The default 'frequency' keeps the memory/CPU footprint low on high-cardinality columns; set this field and the threshold to null to disable the automatic mode.
high_cardinality_encoding.title: High Cardinality Encoding

hashing_n_components.description: Number of binary columns per categorical column for 'hashing' encoding (>= 1). Controls the dimensionality of the output features: the growth in the number of features does not depend on the column cardinality.
hashing_n_components.title: Hashing N Components

target_encoding_smoothing.description: Smoothing parameter (m) of target encoding (>= 0). At m=0 the pure mean of the target variable per category is used; at large m rare categories approach the global mean.
target_encoding_smoothing.title: Target Encoding Smoothing

target_encoding_fallback.description: Fallback value of target encoding for categories not present in the training set. None — the global mean of the target variable.
target_encoding_fallback.title: Target Encoding Fallback

parallel_strategy.description: Parallelization strategy.Currently only 'algorithms' is supported (each algorithm in its own thread/process).

max_workers.description: Maximum number of threads/processes.If null, the number of CPU cores is used
max_workers.title: Max Workers

parallel_mode.description: Concurrency mode: threads (for I/O-bound tasks) or processes (for CPU-intensive computations)
parallel_mode.title: Parallel Mode

phase_timeout.description: Global timeout for the whole HPO phase (in seconds). If None — the default value of 3600 seconds (1 hour) is used. Supported only in parallel_mode='processes', where it is hard: hung workers are forcibly terminated. In parallel_mode='threads' timeouts are forbidden and are a config error: an already running Python function cannot be interrupted, so a soft timeout does not save time and only discards the ready results of completed algorithms.
phase_timeout.title: Phase Timeout

task_timeout.description: Timeout for a single task (algorithm) within a phase (in seconds). If None — phase_timeout or the global timeout is used. Counted from the moment the task actually starts, not from the moment it was submitted to the pool: while a task waits in the queue (more algorithms than max_workers), it does not expire before starting. Supported only in parallel_mode='processes', where it is hard. In parallel_mode='threads' timeouts are forbidden and are a config error: an already running Python function cannot be interrupted, so a soft timeout does not save time and only discards the ready results of completed algorithms.
task_timeout.title: Task Timeout

pruning.description: Early stopping (pruning) settings for Optuna trials. Disabled by default: each trial runs to completion.

feature_selection.description: Feature space reduction settings. By default mode='disabled' — feature selection is not applied.

sanity_gate.description: Thresholds and settings of the Sanity Gate audit for select steps with strategy: sanity_gate. The section is an optional source of thresholds (corridor, top_k_candidates, audit limits), not a behavioral flag: selection is performed only by explicit select phases in general.phases. Having the section without sanity select steps is valid

complexity_guard.description: Settings of the adaptive complexity guard for tree/boosting search spaces on small data (mode: 'off'/'warn'/'apply', lossless/regularize levels, user_range_policy, size-mode thresholds, size_basis). See API_REFERENCE.md.

inf_policy.description: Policy for infinite values (±inf) in numeric features: 'as_missing' (default) — replace them with NaN and log a WARNING listing the columns and counts (missing values are imputed by the preprocessor); 'error' — reject the data with a ValueError naming the columns.
inf_policy.title: Inf Policy

datetime_policy.description: Policy for datetime/timedelta columns (not handled by any transformer and previously silently dropped): 'expand' (default) — replace each column with derived numeric components (year, month, day, dayofweek, and hour if it is non-zero) and log a WARNING listing the generated columns; 'drop' — remove the columns and log a WARNING; 'error' — reject the data with a ValueError naming the columns.
datetime_policy.title: Datetime Policy

drop_id_like_columns.description: Whether ID-like columns (object/string with nunique/n >= 0.95, or a unique monotonic integer column) are dropped from the feature matrix. False (default) — such columns are only reported with a WARNING naming them; true — they are removed. ID-like columns are typically uninformative for regression and can slow training down dramatically.
drop_id_like_columns.title: Drop Id Like Columns

GeneralCfg.title: GeneralCfg

HPOPhaseCfg.description:
Configuration of a single pipeline step.

The class describes the parameters of a specific step: an HPO phase
(``all_algorithms`` / ``refine``) or an explicit selection step
(``select``), enabling multi-stage search and selection strategies
(for example: search across all models → audited select → fine-tuning
finalists → final winner select).

Attributes:
    name (str): Unique phase identifier.
    n_trials (int): Iteration (trial) limit for HPO phases
        (``all_algorithms`` / ``refine``), default
        ``DEFAULT_PHASE_N_TRIALS``. Ignored for ``select``.
    action (str): Action type: 'all_algorithms' (search across all
        algorithms), 'refine' (fine-tune the whole input set
        with warm-start) or 'select' (selection step). The legacy value
        'refine_winner' was removed: configs containing it are rejected
        by validation with a migration hint.
    strategy (Literal['cv_best', 'sanity_gate'] | None): Select step
        strategy (only for action='select'): ranking by CV score
        ('cv_best') or a Sanity Gate audit ('sanity_gate').
    output (Literal['winner', 'top_k', 'pool'] | None): What the
        select step returns (only for action='select'): 'winner' — a
        single winner (terminal step), 'top_k' — the top-K candidates,
        'pool' — the entire corridor pool of finalists.
    k (int | None): Number of candidates (>= 1) for output='top_k'.
        Required only for output='top_k'; forbidden for
        output='winner'/'pool'.

name.description: User-defined name of the optimization phase (for example, 'coarse_search' or 'fine_tuning')
name.title: Name

n_trials.description: Number of iterations (trials) for HPO phases (all_algorithms / refine). Ignored for action='select'
n_trials.title: N Trials

action.description: Phase action: 'all_algorithms' — search across all algorithms, 'refine' — fine-tune the whole input set with warm-start, 'select' — explicit selection step (strategy governs the strategy, output the output shape). The legacy 'refine_winner' is removed: use the pair 'select' (cv_best) + 'refine'
action.title: Action

strategy.description: Select step strategy (only for action='select'): 'cv_best' — ranking by CV score, 'sanity_gate' — finalist pool + ModelSanityGate audit + ranking by RMSE_oof. Forbidden for all_algorithms/refine phases
strategy.title: Strategy

output.description: Output shape of the select step (only for action='select'): 'winner' — a single winner (terminal step), 'top_k' — the top-K candidates (requires the k parameter), 'pool' — the entire corridor pool of finalists. Forbidden for all_algorithms/refine phases
output.title: Output

k.description: Number of candidates (>= 1) for output='top_k'; required only for output='top_k', forbidden for output='winner'/'pool'. Forbidden for all_algorithms/refine phases
k.title: K

HPOPhaseCfg.title: HPOPhaseCfg

An explicit user override of the preprocessing preset.

It may be specified partially or fully: ``None`` in a field means "keep the
automatically selected value". Invalid values are rejected at the config
validation stage (Pydantic) with a clear message.

imputation_strategy.description: Override of the missing value imputation strategy ('mean' or 'median'). None — automatic selection.
imputation_strategy.title: Imputation Strategy

scaling.description: Scaling override ('standard', 'robust' or 'none'). None — automatic selection.
scaling.title: Scaling

PruningCfg.description:
Early stopping (pruning) settings for trials in the HPO phase.

Intermediate evaluation mechanism: when enabled, the tuner publishes a
quality estimate after every natural validation step (for example, after
each cross-validation fold), allowing the Optuna pruner to discard an
obviously hopeless trial before the full evaluation finishes.
For validation strategies without natural steps (hold-out /
train_test_split) the pruner is not applied — the behavior is safe and
documented (see API_REFERENCE.md).

Attributes:
    enable (bool): Global flag enabling early stopping.
        Default is False — the feature is off and trials run to completion.
    strategy (PruningStrategy): Pruning strategy: 'median'
        (optuna.pruners.MedianPruner) or 'hyperband'
        (optuna.pruners.HyperbandPruner).
    min_steps (int): Minimum number of intermediate steps (for example,
        CV folds) before the first pruning decision. For 'median' this is
        n_warmup_steps, for 'hyperband' — min_resource.
    n_startup_trials (int): Number of completed trials after which pruning
        is enabled (only for 'median'; analogous to
        n_startup_trials in Optuna).
    reduction_factor (int): Budget reduction factor between Hyperband
        rounds (only for 'hyperband'; controls pruning aggressiveness).

enable.description: Flag enabling early stopping (pruning) of Optuna trials. Default is False — each trial runs to completion.
enable.title: Enable

min_steps.description: Minimum number of intermediate steps (for example, folds of cross-validation) before the first pruning decision. For 'median' maps to n_warmup_steps, for 'hyperband' — min_resource
min_steps.title: Min Steps

n_startup_trials.description: Number of completed trials after which pruning is enabled (only for 'median'; analogous to n_startup_trials in Optuna)
n_startup_trials.title: N Startup Trials

reduction_factor.description: Budget reduction factor between Hyperband rounds (only for 'hyperband'; pruning aggressiveness)
reduction_factor.title: Reduction Factor

PruningCfg.title: PruningCfg

PruningStrategy.description: Supported early stopping (pruning) strategies for Optuna trials.
PruningStrategy.title: PruningStrategy

SanityGateCfg.description:
Thresholds and settings of the Sanity Gate audit.

        The section is exclusively a **source of thresholds** for select steps
        with ``strategy: sanity_gate`` (finalist pool: corridor δ from the
        leader ∩ hard cap ``top_k_candidates``, optional soft family
        complementation; the audit thresholds of ``ModelSanityGate`` are passed
        to the gate constructor unchanged). There is no longer a global switch:
        the ``mode`` field was removed together with the ``warn_only`` semantics —
        selection happens ONLY via explicit ``select`` steps in
        ``general.phases``, and diagnostics are available in the gate section of
        each select step's report.

        Having the section without select steps with ``strategy: sanity_gate``
        is valid: the section is an optional source of thresholds, not a
        behavioral flag.

Attributes:
            top_k_candidates (int): Hard cap on the finalist pool size (>= 1).
            corridor_delta (float): Relative corridor width δ (in (0, 1)).
            corridor_mode (CorridorMode): 'multiplicative' | 'additive' | 'auto'.
            enforce_family_diversity (bool): Enable soft family complementation.
            algorithm_families (dict[str, str] | None): Map of "algorithm → family".
            allowed_families (list[str] | None): Families taking part in the complementation.
            family_diversity_multiplier (float): Expanded corridor multiplier.
            min_prediction_diversity (float): Circuit A threshold (in (0, 1]);
                computed on OOF predictions. Applied only in the
                non-adaptive mode (adaptive_diversity=false).
            adaptive_diversity (bool): Adaptive mode for circuit A
                (default True): comparison with the constant model —
                zero prediction variance and models worse than the
                constant prediction (R²_oof < 0) fail.
            min_unique_count (int): Absolute minimum nunique for circuit B (>= 1).
            min_unique_ratio (float): Lower bound for the fraction of unique values (in (0, 1]).
                Applied as ``min_unique_ratio * N`` capped by the number of distinct
                target values (a perfect model always reaches the cap).
            max_dead_feature_ratio (float): Circuit C threshold (in [0, 1]) — a signal
                for linear models; standalone disqualification only when
                ``dead_features_require_low_diversity=true`` and diversity is low.
            dead_features_require_low_diversity (bool): Combined rule
                "many dead features AND low diversity".
            zero_coef_tolerance (float): Zero coefficient tolerance (>= 0).
            max_generalization_gap (float): Circuit D threshold (>= 1, default 1.5).
            generalization_gap_mode (GeneralizationGapMode): Circuit D mode
                (default 'warn'): 'warn' — a circuit D violation (a finite gap
                above the threshold or an infinite gap from division by zero)
                goes to soft_warnings (a soft warning); 'reject' — a failure →
                reasons → disqualification (the old strict behavior).
                Reasons in both modes — only contract violations and
                non-computability.
            check_permutation_sensitivity (bool): Enable the permutation audit of
                feature sensitivity (circuit C, for non-linear models).
            permutation_max_rows (int): Row subsample used for permutations (>= 1).
            permutation_max_features (int): Cap on the checked columns (>= 1).
            permutation_repeats (int): Permutation repeats (>= 1).
            permutation_seed (int): Fixed permutation seed.
            permutation_tolerance (float): Feature "deadness" threshold (>= 0).
            audit_time_budget_seconds (float): Time budget for the audit phase
                (>= 0; 0 means unlimited).
            check_diversity (bool): Enable circuit A.
            check_unique (bool): Enable circuit B.
            check_dead_features (bool): Enable circuit C.
            check_generalization_gap (bool): Enable circuit D.

top_k_candidates.description: Hard cap on the finalist pool size (>= 1, default 3).
top_k_candidates.title: Top K Candidates

corridor_delta.description: Relative corridor width δ from the leader (strictly in (0, 1), default 0.15).
corridor_delta.title: Corridor Delta

corridor_mode.description: Shape of the finalist pool corridor: 'multiplicative', 'additive' or 'auto' (chosen based on the metric type, default 'auto').
corridor_mode.title: Corridor Mode

enforce_family_diversity.description: Optional soft complementation of missing families into the finalist pool (default False — disabled).
enforce_family_diversity.title: Enforce Family Diversity

algorithm_families.description: Map of 'algorithm → family' for the family complementation rule. None — algorithms without a classification are treated as their own family.
algorithm_families.title: Algorithm Families

allowed_families.description: Families taking part in the family complementation rule (None — all are allowed).
allowed_families.title: Allowed Families

family_diversity_multiplier.description: Multiplier of the expanded corridor for family complementation (> 0).
family_diversity_multiplier.title: Family Diversity Multiplier

min_prediction_diversity.description: Circuit A (diversity) threshold: Var(y_pred_oof)/Var(y) >= threshold; computed on OOF predictions (strictly in (0, 1], default 0.15). Applied only in the non-adaptive mode (adaptive_diversity=false).
min_prediction_diversity.title: Min Prediction Diversity

adaptive_diversity.description: Adaptive mode for circuit A (default True): comparison with a constant model — zero variance in predictions (a tie with the constant baseline) and models worse than the constant prediction (R²_oof < 0) fail; the absolute min_prediction_diversity threshold is not applied.
adaptive_diversity.title: Adaptive Diversity

min_unique_count.description: Absolute lower bound for nunique in circuit B (>= 1).
min_unique_count.title: Min Unique Count

min_unique_ratio.description: Lower bound for the fraction of unique predictions in circuit B (in (0, 1]). Applied as min_unique_ratio * N capped by the number of distinct target values (a perfect model always reaches the cap).
min_unique_ratio.title: Min Unique Ratio

max_dead_feature_ratio.description: Threshold for the fraction of 'dead' features in circuit C (in [0, 1]) — for linear models this is a signal; standalone disqualification only when dead_features_require_low_diversity=true and diversity is low.
max_dead_feature_ratio.title: Max Dead Feature Ratio

dead_features_require_low_diversity.description: Combined circuit C rule: disqualification only on the combination of 'many dead features AND low diversity'.
dead_features_require_low_diversity.title: Dead Features Require Low Diversity

zero_coef_tolerance.description: Coefficients with |coef| <= the threshold are considered zero (circuit C).
zero_coef_tolerance.title: Zero Coef Tolerance

max_generalization_gap.description: Circuit D threshold: RMSE_oof/RMSE_full > threshold — overfitting.
max_generalization_gap.title: Max Generalization Gap

generalization_gap_mode.description: Circuit D (generalization gap) mode: 'warn' (default) — a circuit D violation (a finite gap > max_generalization_gap or an infinite gap from division by zero: RMSE_full≈0 / RMSE_oof≈0) is recorded in soft_warnings (does not disqualify); 'reject' — a failure → reasons → disqualification (the old strict behavior). Reasons in both modes remain only for contract violations (y_pred_full=None) and non-computability (no finite pairs). The field is deliberately NOT named mode (a collision with the removed sanity_gate.mode field).
generalization_gap_mode.title: Generalization Gap Mode

check_permutation_sensitivity.description: Enable the permutation audit of feature sensitivity (circuit C for non-linear models; controls audit cost). Default is True; False — the permutation path is skipped, the linear coefficient-based path remains.
check_permutation_sensitivity.title: Check Permutation Sensitivity

permutation_max_rows.description: Row subsample for the permutation path of circuit C (>= 1, default 5000).
permutation_max_rows.title: Permutation Max Rows

permutation_max_features.description: Cap on the columns checked in the permutation path (>= 1, default 100).
permutation_max_features.title: Permutation Max Features

permutation_repeats.description: Number of permutation repeats per column (>= 1).
permutation_repeats.title: Permutation Repeats

permutation_tolerance.description: Relative 'deadness' threshold for a feature in permutations.
permutation_tolerance.title: Permutation Tolerance

audit_time_budget_seconds.description: Time budget for the Sanity Gate audit phase (in seconds). 0 — unlimited (default).
audit_time_budget_seconds.title: Audit Time Budget Seconds

SanityGateCfg.title: SanityGateCfg

SearchSpaceEntry.description:
Description of the search space for an individual hyperparameter.

A universal container supporting both categorical lists and numeric
ranges. Implements transparent conversion logic from the shorthand
YAML notation into typed distribution objects.
Attributes:
    config (Union[CategoricalSpace, FloatSpace, IntSpace]): Validated
        object of a concrete distribution type.

The internal ``explicit_type`` flag records whether the distribution type
was written explicitly in the source config (``[low, high, "float"]``) or
inferred from the boundary numbers. Inferred types are re-resolved
against the parameter type (the default search space or the model
signature) by :func:`normalize_hyperparameter_entry` — e.g. an
integral-looking ``[1, 50]`` for a real-valued parameter stays a real
range.
SearchSpaceEntry.title: SearchSpaceEntry

SerializationFormat.description:
Supported model serialization formats.
Rationale: Provides typing and a single source of truth for choosing
between the standard pickle and joblib optimized for heavy weights.
SerializationFormat.title: SerializationFormat

Root object of the whole AutoML configuration system.

Aggregates all configuration sections and performs the final validation
of the parameter graph integrity, including system dependency checks.

    general (GeneralCfg): General experiment parameters.
    oversampling (OversamplingCfg): Data preprocessing settings.
    algorithms (AlgorithmsConfig): Registry of available and active algorithms.

algorithms.description: Dictionary of algorithms, where the key is the algorithm name (for example, 'xgboosting', 'random_forest')
